en: Your room is back in the ready room
translation: Sua sala voltou para a sala de espera
note: Notice while watching a replay: the room has moved on to its next race.
Screen-reader name of the replay's play button.
Screen-reader name of the replay's pause button.
Screen-reader name of the replay's speed button; {speed} is the current speed (1, 2…), × is the times sign.
Screen-reader name: follow the previous racer in the replay.
Screen-reader name: follow the next racer in the replay.
Replay button: play it again from the start.
Replay button: return to the results screen.
Button at the end of a replay: play it again.

en: This replay drifted from the race
translation: Este replay se desviou da corrida
note: Notice when a replay stopped matching the race it recorded.

en: This replay was made with a different version of the game
translation: Este replay foi feito com outra versão do jogo
note: Why a replay cannot be played: it was recorded by another version.
Hint over a replay with its controls hidden, on a touch screen.

translation: Aperte um botão para ver os controles
note: The same hint with a controller.

en: Move the mouse or press a key for controls
translation: Mova o mouse ou aperte uma tecla
note: The same hint with a mouse or keyboard.
Results tag on racers who share a place.

en: The replay is not ready yet.
note: Results: Watch replay is disabled because the replay has not arrived yet.
Screen-reader name of the results list.
Results button: watch the race's replay.
A Survival result: the best floor reached.
A Survival result: the best floor and when it was reached ({time} is m:ss.hh).
A Survival result for a racer who fell below their rising screen: their best floor and when they went out ({time} is m:ss.hh).
An empty seat in the room, waiting for a racer.
Shown to the host in an empty seat's status slot: tap the seat to add a computer racer. 'CPU' is the arcade word for a computer-controlled player; keep it if your language's games use it.
Screen-reader name of an empty seat's button, for the host: adds a computer racer.
A computer racer's seat, in the status slot where a person's Ready sits.
Screen-reader name of a computer racer's seat button, for the host; {name} is the racer's name (Blaze, Koi, Sunny or Moth).
Tag on the player's own seat.
Tag on the player's own seat: tap to change character.
Tag on the seat of the player who made the room.
Select and character pages: a small badge on a stage, song or character tile the player has just unlocked and not yet looked at. Drawn in capitals in Latin scripts; one short word.
A tile from a downloadable pack that is not out yet: its button label, and the line on its pack's sheet.
Screen reader name of the button on a not-yet-released pack's slide. {pack} is the pack's description, e.g. "DLC · Neon pack".
Screen reader name of a picker slide the player has just unlocked: "Stage, 3 of 4: Snow Shrine, new". Same as select_item_position, plus that it is new.
Screen reader name of a character tile the player has just unlocked and not yet looked at. {label} is the character's name.
Results: the banner across the top when a race unlocks a song. Drawn in capitals in Latin scripts; a short shout.
Results: the banner across the top when a race unlocks a character, in the fighting-game tradition of a new challenger appearing. A short shout.
Said to a screen reader (and shown in the replay window's status line) when a song unlocks. {title} is the song's title, never translated.
Said to a screen reader (and shown in the replay window's status line) when a character unlocks. {name} is the character's name.
Replay window: an icon button that downloads the race as a video file. Its tooltip and screen reader name.
Replay window: an icon button that opens the device's share sheet with the race video. Its tooltip and screen reader name.
Replay window: shown under the two video buttons when this race has no recording to save or share.

translation: Os vídeos mostram o nome de todos
note: Replay window: said once, the first time a player shares a video, so they know the other players' names are in it.

en: Could not share the video. Use Save instead.
translation: Não foi possível compartilhar o vídeo. Use Salvar
note: Replay window status line: the share sheet failed; the Save button still works.

en: This browser cannot share videos. Use Save instead.
translation: Este navegador não compartilha vídeos. Use Salvar
note: Replay window status line: this browser has no way to share a video file; the Save button still works.

translation: Não foi possível compartilhar o vídeo.
note: Replay window status line inside a host page's frame, where there is no Save button: the share sheet failed.
Replay window status line inside a host page's frame, where there is no Save button: this browser has no way to share a video file.
The message sent along with a shared race video when nobody won (e.g. a Survival race). {stage} is the stage's name.
The message sent along with a shared race video. {winner} is a player's name; {stage} is the stage's name.
Shouted by Blaze, a brash computer racer, as it pulls well ahead. Cocky, playful.
Shouted by Blaze, a brash computer racer, as it charges to catch up. All-out, reckless.
Shouted by Sunny, a showboating computer racer, as it pulls well ahead and shows off.
Shouted by Sunny, a showboating computer racer, as it falls behind: asking the leader to slow down.
Sighed by Moth, a nervous computer racer, relieved to be ahead.
Squeaked by Moth, a nervous computer racer, panicking as it falls behind.

en: Land on every floor to finish the climb. Missed one? Drop back to collect it, or restart your ascent.
translation: Pouse em todos os andares para terminar. Perdeu um? Desça para pegá-lo ou reinicie a escalada.
note: Ready room, finite 20/50-floor races. Every floor needs credit; a missed floor can be collected by descending. Reset is optional.
A small badge beside the default race mode (Survival) in the ready room's Floors row, marking it as the one to try. One word; drawn in capitals by the stylesheet.

en: Push into the side of a floor to bounce higher. Land on top for it to count.
translation: Empurre a lateral de um andar para quicar mais alto. Pouse em cima para contar.
note: Practice/ready help. Pushing into the side of a floor makes the racer bounce higher but does not count the floor; landing on top does.

en: Drag to steer · flick down to fast fall · stay above the lava
translation: Arraste para mover · deslize para baixo para cair · fique acima da lava
note: One-time swipe coach in Survival. No restart exists. Keep the lava reminder and both input instructions.

en: Missed a floor below — drop back to collect it.
translation: Faltou um andar abaixo. Desça para pegá-lo.
note: Finite-race HUD recovery reminder, paired with a downward platform arrow. Descent can collect the missed floor; it is not dead or unreachable.

en: Nobody's playing. This room closes in 1 minute.
translation: Ninguém está jogando. Esta sala fecha em 1 minuto.
note: A banner, shown a minute before the server closes a room nobody has done anything in for ten minutes. Press the button beside it to keep the room open.
The button on that banner: keeps the room open for another ten minutes.
Large words over the player's racer at the start of a Survival race, until their first input. Keyboard and controller. Any key or button starts them.
The same, on touch. Any tap starts them.

en: The lava caught you. Last racer standing wins.
translation: A lava alcançou você. Vence quem ficar por último.
note: One line under OUT! when the lava catches the player in Survival. Says why, and that the race goes on.
One-time toast in a keyboard or controller player's first Survival race. Lava rises from below; use the same word for lava as tutorial_ready_body.

en: Land on every floor to the top. Missed one? Go back down and land on it.
translation: Pouse em todos os andares até o topo. Perdeu um? Desça e pouse nele.
note: One-time toast at the start of a player's first 20- or 50-floor race: every floor counts.

en: Press R to start again from the bottom.
translation: Aperte R para reiniciar de baixo.
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. R is a key legend and stays R.

en: Press {glyph} to start again from the bottom.
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. {glyph} is the controller's button picture; keep it once.

en: Tap the timer to start again from the bottom.
translation: Toque no relógio para reiniciar de baixo.
note: One-time toast in the same race: how to start the climb over. The timer is the race clock at the top of the screen.
Quick-action button on the title (and the title of its dialog) that opens the short carousel of how-to-play demos. One short plain word.
Button that moves the how-to-play carousel to the next demo.
Button on the last demo of the how-to-play carousel; it closes the carousel.

en: You bounce by yourself. Land on the next floor.
translation: Você pula sozinho. Caia no próximo andar.
note: Caption under a looping demo: the climber bounces without help and lands on the next floor. Plain words a child understands.

en: Some floors move. Wait, then hop.
translation: Alguns andares se mexem. Espere e pule.
note: Caption under a looping demo: some floors slide sideways; wait, then hop onto one.
Caption under a looping demo: lava rises from below; stay above it.
Caption under a looping demo: four climbers race; the first to the top wins.
Title of the dialog shown once to a player who starts a multiplayer match without having seen how to play.

en: A quick look shows you how to climb.
translation: Uma olhada rápida mostra como subir.
note: One line under the title of that dialog: a quick look shows how to climb.
Main button of that dialog: opens the how-to-play carousel.
Button of that dialog: starts the short story instead.
Button of that dialog: skip the help and go on to the match.
Story HUD objective chip, top centre: climb to this floor. {floor} is a number.
Story HUD objective chip: drop hard onto a lamp to break it open.
Story HUD objective chip: climb back down to the friend named {name}.
Story HUD objective chip while lava chases: climb fast to floor {floor}.
Under the story's edge arrow: how many floors away the target is ({count} is 2 or more).
Under the story's edge arrow: the target is one floor away.
Story HUD chip beside an arrow: a gust of wind is blowing or about to.
Story HUD flash: the game saved the player's restart point here.
A chapter's count of glims (tiny living lights) carried: {count} of {total}. Hub card and HUD.
Small label above a story chapter's name: Chapter 1, Chapter 2 and so on.
The ending: {count} (2 or more) glims the player carried light up the sky.
The ending: the one glim the player carried lights up the sky.
Credits: who made the game. SNEKPRTY is a name; keep it as is.
Credits: the story's title, 'Don't Look Down' (the game's motto).
Last line of the credits: thanks for playing the story.
Button: go to the story's chapter list.
Story chapter list, under the heading: stars and glims collected over every chapter.
Story chapter list: a locked chapter; the player must finish the chapter {number} first.
Screen reader text on a chapter card: how many of its three stars are earned.
Pause menu in the story: restart this chapter from its start.
Heading of the results after a story chapter is finished.
Results, first star: the chapter was finished.
Results, second star earned: every glim carried, {count} of {total}.
Results, third star earned: the time {time} beat the target {par} (both like 1:05).
Results, second star not earned: what it takes (find all {total} glims).
Results, third star not earned: finish faster than {par} (like 1:05).
Results button: play the same chapter again.
